description_en: Checks whether a user is authorized to use Key Management Service (KMS)
kebab_example: aliyun polardb check-kms-authorized --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id pc-000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckKMSAuthorized

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319134.html operation to query information about the available regions of the destination account, including region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319134.html接口查看目标账号下的可用地域信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319131.html operation to query information about all clusters in the destination region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319131.html接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The region where the transparent data encryption (TDE) key is located
parameters.name: tde_region

AuthorizationState.description_en:
The authorization status. Valid values:

0: Unauthorized.

1: Authorized
AuthorizationState.description_zh:
授权状态。取值范围如下：

0：未授权。

1：已授权
